gates.standard_gate: Design/form (production-standard.md §4; the standard receipt template omits it)
gates.command: Godot headless: the _silhouettes rules of engines/godot/tests/test_read_pets.gd:64-120 run on the imported master, with parts found through the contract's identity.proportion_landmarks.part_map (card CHAR-READ, to build); the W15 metrics (E/H, tip/VB, tail/ear; docs/qa/w15/ART.md:94-120) on V3 and VH stills in simple shading. Coat colour is a separate check (_coats, test_read_pets.gd:122).
gates.runs_here: The test: Expected to run on this machine's CPU; the tool is not built (card CHAR-READ) and nothing about it is measured here. Say "measured" only after one recorded run. The stills: renders, in a quiet window only.
gates.pass_rule: Every contract identity.proportion_landmarks rule and the design_form criteria (B1, B2) hold on the imported GLB at the contract camera. The blockout checkpoint is recorded first; it never stands in for this export's run.

blockout_checkpoint.rule: SKILL Build step 1: primary forms and silhouette at V30 and V3 in simple shading, before skeleton detail, materials or fur. Recorded once per foundation; does not satisfy this gate.

gates.command: node tools/assets/validate-glb.mjs on the master and the web variant, with the character rules of card CHAR-VAL: one skin per skeleton; contract rig.required_bones present; bone names [A-Za-z0-9_]; <= rig.max_skin_influences per vertex; weight sums within rig.weight_sum_tolerance; deform bones, triangles and primitives per LOD within budgets; clip names and loop modes from the clip table; in-place root; socket_rifle and Muzzle present; feet pivot; +Z front.
gates.runs_here: validate-glb.mjs runs here (Node, measured on the 6 static Lot kit GLBs). Expected to run on this machine's CPU; the tool is not built (card CHAR-VAL) and nothing about it is measured here. Say "measured" only after one recorded run. Today the validator has no skin, weight or clip rule (tools/assets/validate-glb.mjs:155-156): this gate cannot pass before CHAR-VAL lands.
gates.pass_rule: Exit 0 on the exact hashed export; the report saved as evidence; measured_results filled (rule 7 of tools/assets/check-char-contract.mjs). Every warning is listed in the evidence with an impact note (benign, or the defect it causes); a warning count alone is not a pass or a fail (production-standard.md §4).

gates.command: GODOT=<Godot 4.7.2> bash tools/godot/run.sh assets/masters/Char_<Species>_Rifleman.glb, with tools/godot/validate_glb.gd extended for Skeleton3D, bone count, AnimationPlayer clip names and loop modes (CHAR-VAL).
gates.runs_here: Godot 4.7.2 headless import is measured here for static kit GLBs only (tools/godot/run.sh). A skinned, animated GLB import is unmeasured here: the first R1 step is one test-skeleton import in a quiet window. run.sh ignores the import step's exit code (|| true), so the import log is part of the evidence.
gates.pass_rule: Exit 0 on the exact hashed export, never inherited (it always runs on the new export); the import log has no error and is the evidence. Every warning is listed in the evidence with an impact note (benign, or the defect it causes); a warning count alone is not a pass or a fail (production-standard.md §4).

gates.command: Numeric: a Node probe that skins the master on the CPU at every clip key and aim pitch in -0.9..+0.9 (card CHAR-POSE, to build): DT1 plate rigidity, the rifle_mount thresholds and clearance (DT5), DT9 at 4 influences. CHAR-POSE strips textures first (glTF-Transform) or computes skinning without a DOM, because three's GLTFLoader needs image decoding Node lacks; one load is measured before this says it runs. Visual: a pose sheet of every contract.deformation_tests entry at the clip extremes, Godot Forward+.
gates.runs_here: Numeric: Expected to run on this machine's CPU; the tool is not built (card CHAR-POSE) and nothing about it is measured here. Say "measured" only after one recorded run. Pose sheet: renders, in a quiet window only.
gates.pass_rule: Every contract.deformation_tests entry and the rifle_mount contact thresholds hold; the pose sheet is reviewed and its defects ranked.

gates.command: Godot captures of contract.visual_acceptance.motion_sequences (M1-M8 and the DT10 captures) at the locked views (V30, V60, V10, V3, VH) in Forward+ and Compatibility, judged against the blocking criteria whose gate is motion_visual by an independent reviewer; npm run godot for live play.
gates.runs_here: Godot renders on llvmpipe/lavapipe run here for other lanes (their captures); character captures are unmeasured and run in a quiet window only. Captures prove looks at a fixed rate, not feel: feel at frame rate needs a human on a real GPU.
gates.pass_rule: Every blocking criterion of this gate passes, including stop, turn and cancellation (M7, M8): clip endpoints reached or blended, layers reset on respawn, no pose pop, and the camera clear of the pet at the near plane (DT10). The reviewer and their independence are recorded; the dominant defects and the change against the PLACEHOLDER are listed.

limitations: No GPU on the build box (llvmpipe, lavapipe, SwiftShader only).
gates.command: A human on budgets.target_hardware: the PLACEHOLDER (R0a) and the candidate measured in the same session, scene, camera path, resolution and hardware, with declared warmup and sample count; the p95 of the difference at each budgets.simultaneous_character_test_counts entry. GPU or CPU attribution only through a named instrument (Godot RenderingServer GPU timestamps / the viewport render-time API; the Performance monitors for CPU animation), else "frame total only". Also texture residency, draws per pass, fur-card overdraw and LOD switches under load.
gates.runs_here: Unsupported on the build box: no GPU, software rasterisers only, and headless or fixed-rate runs do not establish real-time performance (production-standard.md §8).
gates.pass_rule: Within budgets.incremental_p95_frame_time_budget_ms, cpu_animation_update_ms_per_character, transparent_overdraw and resident_texture_memory_mib on budgets.target_hardware (all open: OD-3). Never inherited: any change to triangles, bones, materials, textures or clips reruns it.

gates.standard_gate: Project addition (contract rights; production-standard.md §9 dependency/rights record)
gates.command: Review of the rights record: contract.rights filled for the route used (a field that does not apply is { "not_applicable": "<reason>" }); every input and tool hashed or versioned in the assets/manifest.json provenance; the owner sign-off for any upload, spend or licence reading; no AGPL or non-commercial component shipped, linked or served (docs/qa/char/ROUTES.md).
gates.runs_here: Yes (paperwork). Owner sign-offs are owner actions.
gates.pass_rule: No null rights field for the route used; every owner sign-off the route needs is on record.

gates.standard_gate: Project addition (preserve the controller; SKILL step 4)
gates.command: Godot headless test (test_char_fit.gd, to build): origin at the feet, yaw 0 faces -Z after the adapter (on a child of Model), socket_rifle at the rifle mount (GLB and runtime positions), Muzzle present, aim pitch +-0.9 clear of the head, step_offset kept, render mesh on no physics layer, model meta placeholder kept while not accepted; the camera_rig check (DT10: arm pulled in by a wall, no triangle inside the near plane or over the crosshair and hit-cue ring); every avatar_contract member mapped; plus a measured report of hitbox vs visual.
gates.runs_here: Expected to run on this machine's CPU; the tool is not built (card test_char_fit.gd) and nothing about it is measured here. Say "measured" only after one recorded run.
gates.pass_rule: Every contract.controller_contract item holds, the camera_rig check included. The hitbox vs visual report is recorded; changing the hitbox waits for OD-6.

gates.command: node tools/aaa-30m.mjs run --configs compat,fplus --sha <rev> --out <dir> --baseline <PLACEHOLDER baseline dir> (uncommitted at f7f45b5; it must land first). Needs a matte adapter that writes the GLB's armour, coat and other materials as the tool's matte codes (tools/aaa-30m.mjs:114-116).
gates.runs_here: Godot configs only: software renders in a quiet window only (the four-config run takes about 30 min, a lane claim). The matte adapter is not built.
gates.pass_rule: Blocking criteria A1, A2 and B4 in both Godot configs, and the regression exit code is 0 (per number, noise floor 2). The twin configs are not part of this gate (engine_parity_twin).

gates.standard_gate: Project addition (production-standard.md §8 LOD by projected size)
gates.command: node tools/aaa-30m.mjs run --configs compat,fplus with each LOD forced, plus the M5 walk-in captures; the projected-height LOD function (contract lod_selection) in both engines.
gates.runs_here: Renders, in a quiet window only.
gates.pass_rule: Blocking criterion F2: no identity, team or silhouette pop; A1 holds at every forced LOD in both Godot configs.

gates.command: node tools/assets/make-web-variant.mjs <master>, validate-glb.mjs on the web variant, a Vitest test that loads it with GLTFLoader (clips, one skin, <= 4 influences, socket_rifle, Muzzle), the twin adapter behind src/client/views/avatar.ts unchanged (every member and trigger per the contract avatar_contract), node tools/aaa-30m.mjs run --configs webgl,webgpu, and the PARITY rows.
gates.runs_here: Node and SwiftShader renders, in a quiet window; the GLTFLoader load of a skinned master is unmeasured here.
gates.pass_rule: Receiver criteria P1 and P2: the web variant derives from this receipt's master export_hash (the proof's version); the twin configs pass the A1 thresholds; every look difference is logged in PARITY. Only then may the twin drop its PLACEHOLDER tag.

director_decision.required_basis: Equals contract visual_acceptance.director_review_required (proposed true, OD-9); the checker refuses a receipt that disagrees with its contract. Director = the owner.

note: Template only. Acceptance requires evidence for this exact export and every relevant required gate; not_applicable needs a recorded justification. Director approval is required only when the project contract requires it. Inherited gate evidence must identify unchanged relevant dependencies and the prior result; required face/speech and other role-specific gates must be added and completed. Project: copy to assets/characters/<id>/receipt-<export sha256 first 8>.json; a gate with required_for "receiver:<name>" gates that receiver's adoption, not production acceptance; check with node tools/assets/check-char-contract.mjs <receipt> --contract assets/characters/<id>/contract.json.

role_specific_gates.standard_gate: Role-specific (project addition): corgi vs cat at range
role_specific_gates.command: The tools/aaa-30m.mjs 4x crops and a V60 lineup judged 1:1 by an independent reviewer (A3); the landmark rules of design_form re-checked on the skinned mesh in Idle, Walk, Run and Plant (DT6, DT7).
role_specific_gates.runs_here: Renders in a quiet window; the numeric re-check on the CPU.
role_specific_gates.pass_rule: Species reads 1:1 at V30 and V60 in both Godot configs (A3); the species cues hold in motion (DT6, DT7).

role_specific_gates.standard_gate: Role-specific (project addition): Deformation/contact for four feet
role_specific_gates.command: The CHAR-POSE probe over Walk and Run at the species speeds (engines/godot/game/tuning.gd:18-23, walk, run, sprint) with playback rate = speed / stride_length_m: per paw stance windows from the clip table; Idle and Plant hold all four paws.
role_specific_gates.runs_here: Expected to run on this machine's CPU; the tool is not built (card CHAR-POSE) and nothing about it is measured here. Say "measured" only after one recorded run.
role_specific_gates.pass_rule: Every paw within its contact thresholds (height_error_m, slip_m_per_stance) in every stance window of the clip table at every tested speed; no paw below ground; stride metadata present for every locomotion clip.

role_specific_gates.justification: Closed mouths, no speech, no face rig: engines/godot/tests/test_read_pets.gd:57 forbids mouth and tongue parts, and contract rig.required_morph_targets is empty.

evidence_rule: Each evidence entry (gates and receiver proofs) is { path, sha256, export_hash, engine, renderer, camera, conditions }, every field filled ("n/a" where a field cannot apply, e.g. the renderer of a paperwork gate). A current_export pass binds every entry to this receipt's export_hash or web_variant_hash.
